questions.prompt: Evaluate whether the task is explicitly well-defined, or if it involves ambiguity, missing context, and complex problem solving:

options.luna: Explicitly defined tasks, direct execution, translation, formatting, standard code generation, or routine Q&A.
options.sol: Ambiguous instructions, finding unstructured information, handling gaps in context, complex logic puzzles, or multi-step planning.

questions.prompt: Select the required internal reasoning effort based on task complexity, speed constraints, and correctness requirements:

options.mid: Straightforward, context-rich tasks (e.g., minor code fixes), short rewrites, or tasks prioritizing real-time speed.
options.high: Everyday coding, data transformations, document drafting, and moderately complex logical steps.
options.extra_high: Complex debugging, subtle edge-cases, deep algorithmic proofs, or tasks where maximum correctness is critical.
